summary: The diff implements most of the requested requirements. REQ-1 (Stripe subscription flow), REQ-2 (backend ad revenue system), and REQ-3 (frontend ad revenue dashboard + 10-second impression tracking) are all substantially addressed. However, there are a few gaps: PaymentSuccess.tsx does not explicitly call setSubscriptionStatus to upgrade the user (it relies on session verification and query invalidation), and the backend main.mo is truncated so we cannot fully verify all REQ-2 backend endpoints and stable storage persistence.

missing_requirements.requirement: PaymentSuccess.tsx must call setSubscriptionStatus to upgrade the user to premium after successful payment.
missing_requirements.reason: The PaymentSuccess.tsx diff shows it calls getStripeSessionStatus and invalidates queries on success, but does not show an explicit call to setSubscriptionStatus on the actor to persist the premium upgrade in the backend. The subscription upgrade appears to rely solely on session verification without explicitly writing the premium status to the backend.

hallucinated_features.description: A backend/migration.mo module with a full data migration system including OldActor and NewActor type definitions and a run migration function.
hallucinated_features.reason: While the build request requires ad revenue data to be persisted in stable storage, it does not specifically request a migration module or migration infrastructure. This is an implementation detail that goes beyond what was explicitly requested.
